545: enum Fallback<S, E = Infallible> {
546:     Default(Route<E>),
547:     Service(Route<E>),
548:     BoxedHandler(BoxedIntoRoute<S, E>),
549: }
550: 
551: impl<S, E> Fallback<S, E>
552: where
553:     S: Clone,
554: {
555:     fn merge(self, other: Self) -> Option<Self> {
556:         match (self, other) {
557:             (Self::Default(_), pick @ Self::Default(_)) => Some(pick),
558:             (Self::Default(_), pick) | (pick, Self::Default(_)) => Some(pick),
559:             _ => None,
560:         }
561:     }
562: 
563:     fn map<F, E2>(self, f: F) -> Fallback<S, E2>
564:     where
565:         S: 'static,
566:         E: 'static,
567:         F: FnOnce(Route<E>) -> Route<E2> + Clone + Send + 'static,
568:         E2: 'static,
569:     {
570:         match self {
571:             Self::Default(route) => Fallback::Default(f(route)),
572:             Self::Service(route) => Fallback::Service(f(route)),
573:             Self::BoxedHandler(handler) => Fallback::BoxedHandler(handler.map(f)),
574:         }
575:     }
576: 
577:     fn with_state<S2>(self, state: S) -> Fallback<S2, E> {
578:         match self {
579:             Fallback::Default(route) => Fallback::Default(route),
580:             Fallback::Service(route) => Fallback::Service(route),
581:             Fallback::BoxedHandler(handler) => Fallback::Service(handler.into_route(state)),
582:         }
583:     }
584: 
585:     fn call_with_state(&mut self, req: Request, state: S) -> RouteFuture<E> {
586:         match self {
587:             Fallback::Default(route) | Fallback::Service(route) => {
588:                 RouteFuture::from_future(route.oneshot_inner(req))
589:             }
590:             Fallback::BoxedHandler(handler) => {
591:                 let mut route = handler.clone().into_route(state);
592:                 RouteFuture::from_future(route.oneshot_inner(req))
593:             }
594:         }
595:     }
596: }

600:         match self {
601:             Self::Default(inner) => Self::Default(inner.clone()),
602:             Self::Service(inner) => Self::Service(inner.clone()),
603:             Self::BoxedHandler(inner) => Self::BoxedHandler(inner.clone()),
